generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

technicalCriterionList.description: The intending bidder should have satisfactorily completed (90% of the contract value) as a prime contractor at least one work of similar nature such as structural health assessment/stability analysis/integrity assessment of structural steel/concrete components/ retrofitting works of value not less than Rs.8.81 Lakhs in the preceding five financial years (i.e. 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26) In proof of the same, the work done certificate issued by an officer not below the rank of Chief Engineer in case of KPCL/RPCL works and not below the rank of Executive Engineer/Competent Authority in case of State/Central Government/Government under taking/Public Sector Undertaking/any Private Thermal Power Station/Processing industries/Refineries/ Petrochemicals/fertilizer and steel Industries in India as the case may be uploaded (The value of the completed works shall be given a weight of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the 2026-27)

Any individual/firms/Registered Company/any undertaking Companies/Class-IV Registered KPWD contractor or equivalent to KPWD Class-IV Contractor registered in other State Government/Central Government/Firms are eligible for participation for which scanned copy of the same shall be uploaded

technicalCriterionList.description: The Intending bidder in his name should have achieved in at least two financial years an average annual Financial Turnover (in all classes of civil engineering construction works only) of value not less than Rs.17.62 Lakhs during the preceding five financial years (i.e. 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26). The bidder shall submit certified copy of the turnover certificate duly certified by the chartered Accountant for the respective two years & the same shall be uploaded along with the technical bid. (Financial turnover of previous years shall be given weight at 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of financial year 2026-27)
Bidder should submit declaration as mentioned in page No.04 vide Sl No. 6(iii) as per bid document
Agency should be registered under National Accreditation Board for testing and Calibration Laboratories (NABL) Certificate, and valid certificate to be uploaded

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Conducting NDT tests for A-framed concrete structures of 220kV Switch yard & 220kV control room at RTPS.

itemList.description: Mobilization and de-mobilization of Necessary equipment with material testing accessories with qualified manpower.

Detailed visual inspection of the structure by experts by using hand held instruments like binoculars/zoom in cameras etc including taking photographs & videos at all locations & all heights & submission of detailed report along with soft copy of same in pen drive/CD as per direction of engineer in charge. For 220kV ODY control room building (G+1) & A-frame(10 Nos) RCC structures at 220kV ODY

Conducting basic nondestructive test, Ultrasonic pulse velocity test in field on RCC members including surface preparation, testing, recording observations/readings, interpretation, cost of materials, machinery labour, complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge.

Conducting basic nondestructive test, Half-cell potentiometer test in field on RCC members including surface preparation, testing, recording observations/readings, interpretation, cost of materials, machinery labour, complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge.

Conducting basic nondestructive test, Schmidt rebound hammer test in field on RCC members including surface preparation, testing, recording observations/readings, interpretation, cost of materials, machinery labour, complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge.

Conducting basic nondestructive test, Carbonation tests including surface preparation, testing, recording observations/readings, interpretation, cost of materials, machinery labour, complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge.

Conducting basic nondestructive test, Cover meter test including surface preparation, testing, recording observations/readings, interpretation, cost of materials, machinery labour, complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge.

Conducting basic nondestructive test Chemical analysis (pH, Chlorides and Sulphates) in laboratory, including cost of materials, machinery, labour, complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge

Providing and fixing double scaffolding system (cup lock type) on the exterior side of building/structure, upto 25metre height, above ground level, including additional rows of scaffolding in stepped manner as per requirement of site, made with 40mm dia M.S. tube, placed 1.5 metre centre to centre, horizontal & vertical tubes joint with cup & lock system with M.S. Tubes, M.S. tube challis, M.S. clamps and staircase system in the scaffolding for working platform etc. and maintaining it in a serviceable condition for execution of work of cleaning and/ or pointing and/ or applying chemical and removing it thereafter. The scaffolding system shall be stiffened with bracings, runners, connecting with the building etc, wherever required, if feasible, for inspection of work at required locations with essential safety features for the workmen etc., complete as per directions and approval of Engineer-in-charge.

Assimilation of data, analyzing the NDT reports, providing inferences of NDTs and repair methodology to be suggested including budgetary costs for repairs and submitting six copies of detailed report in hard copy and one CD containing soft copy. Detailed report.
